thig13.5:1.1: daharāhaṃ suddhavasanā yaṃ pure dhammam asuṇiṃ | tassā me appamattāya saccābhisamayo ahu. || ||
thig13.5:2.1: tato 'haṃ sabbakāmesu bhūsaṃ aratim ajjhagaṃ | sakkāyasmiṃ bhayaṃ disvā nekkhammaṃ yeva pihaye. || ||
thig13.5:3.1: hitvān' ahaṃ ñātigaṇaṃ dāsakammakarāni ca | gāmakhettāni bhītāni ramaṇīye pamodite |
thig13.5:4.1: pahāy' ahaṃ pabbajitā sāpateyyam anappakaṃ. || || evaṃ saddhāya nikkhamma saddhamme suppavedite |
thig13.5:5.1: na me taṃ assa patirūpaṃ ākiñcaññaṃ hi patthaye | yā jātarūparajataṃ ṭhapetvā punar āgame. || ||
thig13.5:6.1: rajataṃ jātarūpaṃ vā na bodhāya na santaye | na etaṃ samaṇasāruppaṃ na etaṃ ariyavaḍḍhanaṃ || ||
thig13.5:7.1: lobhanaṃ madanaṃ c' etaṃ mohanaṃ rajavaḍḍhanaṃ | sāsaṅkaṃ bahuāyāsaṃ n' atthi c' ettha dhavaṃ ṭhiti. || ||
thig13.5:8.1: ettha rattā pamattā ca saṃkiliṭṭhamanā narā | aññamaññena byāruddhā puthukubbanti medhagaṃ. || ||
thig13.5:9.1: vadho bandho parikeso jāni sokapariddavo | kāmesu adhipannānaṃ dissate byasanaṃ bahuṃ. || ||
thig13.5:10.1: taṃ mañ ñātī amittā va kiṃ maṃ kāmesu yuñjatha | jānātha maṃ babbajitaṃ kāmesu bhayadassina. || || na
thig13.5:11.1: hiraññasuvaṇṇena parikkhīyanti āsavā | amittā vadhakā kāmā sapattā sallabandhanā. || ||
thig13.5:12.1: taṃ mañ ñātī amittā va kiṃ maṃ kāmesu yuñjatha | jānātha maṃ pabbajitaṃ muṇḍaṃ saṃghāṭipārutaṃ. || ||
thig13.5:13.1: uttiṭṭhapiṇḍo uñcho ca paṃsukūlañ ca cīvaraṃ | etaṃ kho kho mama sāruppaṃ anagārūpanissayo. || ||
thig13.5:14.1: vantā mahesinā kāmā ye dibbā ye ca mānusā | khemaṭṭhāne vimuttā te pattā te acalaṃ sukhaṃ. || ||
thig13.5:15.1: māhaṃ kāmehi saṃgacchiṃ yesu tāṇaṃ na vijjati | amittā vadhakā kāmā aggikhandhūpamā dukhā. || ||
thig13.5:16.1: paripantho eso sabhayo savighāto sakaṇṭako | gedho suvisamo c' eso mahanto mohanāmukho. || ||
thig13.5:17.1: upasaggo bhīmarūpo cakāmā sappasirūpamā | ye bālā abhinandanti andhabhūtā puthujjanā. || ||
thig13.5:18.1: kāmapaṅkasattā hi janā bahū loke aviddasū | pariyantaṃ nābhijānanti jātiyā maraṇassa ca. || ||
thig13.5:19.1: duggatigamanaṃ maggaṃ manussā kāmahetukaṃ | bahuṃ ve paṭipajjanti attano roga-m-āvahaṃ. || ||
thig13.5:20.1: evaṃ amittajananā tāpanā saṃkilesikā | lokāmisā bandhanīyā kāmā maraṇabandhanā. || ||
thig13.5:21.1: ummādanā ullapanā kāmā cittapamāthino | sattānaṃ saṃkilesāya khippaṃ Mārena oḍḍitaṃ. || ||
thig13.5:22.1: anantādīnavā kāmā bahudukkhā mahāvisā | appassādā raṇakarā sukkapakkhavisosanā. || ||
thig13.5:23.1: sāhaṃ etādisaṃ katvā byasanaṃ kāmahetukaṃ | na taṃ paccāgamissāmi nibbānābhiratā sadā. || ||
thig13.5:24.1: raṇaṃ karitvā kāmānaṃ sītibhāvābhikaṅkhinī | appamattā vihissāmi tesaṃ saṃyojanakkhaye. || ||
thig13.5:25.1: asokaṃ virajaṃ khemaṃ ariyaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ ujuṃ | taṃ maggaṃ anugacchāmi yena tiṇṇā mahesino. || ||
thig13.5:26.1: imaṃ passatha dhammaṭṭhaṃ Subbaṃ kammāradhītaraṃ | anejaṃ upasampajja rukkhamūlamhi jhāyati. || ||
thig13.5:27.1: ajj' aṭṭhamī pabbajitā saddhā saddhammasobhaṇā | vinītā Uppalavaṇṇāya tevijjā maccuhāyini. || ||
thig13.5:28.1: sāyaṃ bhujissā anaṇā bhikkhunī bhāvitindriyā | sabbayogavisaṃyuttā katakiccā anāsavā. || ||
thig13.5:29.1: taṃ Sakko devasaṅghena upasaṃgamma iddhiyā | namassati bhūtapati Subhaṃ kammāradhītaran ti. || ||
